name: Negai no Mahou.
source:
Main character used to make up rules in his childhood and awaited rewards from the fate for remaining true to those small rules. In the corner of his heart he still believes in those small miracles. Between the cute transfer student and the childhood friend seeking for romance, it's time for magic of wishes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公小时候常为自己制定一些规则，并期待只要遵守这些小小约定，命运就会给予奖励。在内心一角，他至今仍相信那些小小奇迹。面对可爱的转学生和渴望恋爱的青梅竹马，愿望的魔法即将降临。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-july-2003-komorebi-ni.html]vndbreview[/url]]
